rows.label: tlk70000056_02_msg0001
rows.name:
Aunt Ranea sometimes tied Kei's hair
too.

rows.label: tlk70000056_02_msg0002
rows.name:
She knew all sorts of ways to tie it,
and Kei thought it was like magic.
When we asked how she got so good...

rows.label: tlk70000056_02_msg0003
rows.name:
She said she likes doing hair because
it makes her feel like a different
person.

rows.label: tlk70000056_02_msg0004
rows.name:
She promised to teach me that style.
I wonder what Aunt Rynea is doing
now...
